BUNDLE-INPUT-001.rationale: Both paths reject a requested check when its required build output is absent.

BUNDLE-INPUT-002.rationale: The replacement consumes an explicit typed artifact and does not guess a directory.

BUNDLE-INPUT-003.rationale: The declared media type supports files, packages, binaries, and bounded archives.

BUNDLE-INPUT-004.rationale: The replacement verifies artifact type, size, URL, and digest before measurement.

BUNDLE-MEASURE-001.rationale: Both paths report a total output size for valid input.

BUNDLE-MEASURE-002.rationale: Both paths report the number of measured output files.

BUNDLE-MEASURE-003.rationale: Both paths report the largest files in descending size order.

BUNDLE-MEASURE-004.rationale: The replacement uses exact content bytes instead of allocation blocks and rounded units.

BUNDLE-MEASURE-005.rationale: Compressed archives report both stored bytes and expanded content bytes.

BUNDLE-LIMIT-001.rationale: Both paths can enforce a maximum total output size.

BUNDLE-LIMIT-009.rationale: Both paths can enforce a maximum output file count.

BUNDLE-LIMIT-002.rationale: Both paths fail an authoritative check when the total limit is exceeded.

BUNDLE-LIMIT-003.rationale: The replacement can limit the combined bytes for one named file pattern.

BUNDLE-LIMIT-004.rationale: A declared required pattern fails when no file matches it.

BUNDLE-LIMIT-005.rationale: A verified baseline can limit absolute output growth in bytes.

BUNDLE-LIMIT-006.rationale: A verified baseline can limit output growth as a percentage.

BUNDLE-LIMIT-007.rationale: A blocking replacement check requires an explicit enforceable limit.

BUNDLE-LIMIT-008.rationale: An advisory replacement check can record measurements without a limit.

BUNDLE-BASELINE-001.rationale: Every completed replacement measurement produces a typed immutable baseline artifact.

BUNDLE-BASELINE-002.rationale: Growth checks verify the baseline schema, type, size, and digest.

BUNDLE-RESULT-001.rationale: Both paths produce a clear pass or fail result for an enforced budget.

BUNDLE-RESULT-002.rationale: The replacement stores exact metrics, matches, growth, and largest-file facts.

BUNDLE-RESULT-003.rationale: Bounded logs and a typed baseline remain available as structured evidence.

BUNDLE-SECURITY-001.rationale: Archive parsing rejects unsafe paths and duplicate entries before accepting evidence.

BUNDLE-SECURITY-002.rationale: Archive links, devices, and unsupported extension records are denied.

BUNDLE-SECURITY-003.rationale: Input, expansion, file, path, pattern, evidence, time, and memory use are bounded.

BUNDLE-SECURITY-004.rationale: The replacement scans streams without extraction and declares no network capability.

BUNDLE-RUNTIME-001.rationale: Timeout and cancellation cannot create a passing blocking result.

BUNDLE-RUNTIME-002.rationale: The common runner preserves independent retry attempts and every attempt result.

BUNDLE-SCOPE-001.rationale: A typed dependency places measurement after artifact creation and before live tests.

BUNDLE-SCOPE-002.rationale: The measurement does not deploy, expose, browse, or contact an agent.

BUNDLE-DEFECT-001.rationale: Strict archive parsing rejects symbolic links that could add external bytes.

BUNDLE-DEFECT-002.rationale: Any parse or integrity error ends the attempt instead of accepting partial evidence.

BUNDLE-AUTHORITY-001.rationale: The replacement remains shadow-only throughout implementation and parity.

BUNDLE-AUTHORITY-002.rationale: The old bundle suite remains the only gate authority before cutover.
